# NULLIF returns NULL when its arguments compare equal, otherwise its first argument.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/conditional_expressions#nullif
SELECT NULLIF(a, 1) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> null

SELECT NULLIF(a, 1) FROM t WHERE a = 2
=> "2"

SELECT NULLIF(a, 1) FROM t WHERE a IS NULL
=> null

SELECT NULLIF(a, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) FROM t WHERE a = 2
=> "2"

SELECT NULLIF(b, '') FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "x"

SELECT NULLIF('', '')
=> null

SELECT NULLIF(b'', b'')
=> null

SELECT NULLIF(NUMERIC '1.25', NUMERIC '2.5')
=> "1.25"

SELECT NULLIF(BIGNUMERIC '1.25', BIGNUMERIC '2.5')
=> "1.25"

SELECT NULLIF(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-01-02')
=> "2025-01-01"

SELECT TYPEOF(NULLIF(a, 1)) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "INT64"

SELECT TYPEOF(NULLIF(NUMERIC '1.25', NUMERIC '1.25'))
=> "NUMERIC"

SELECT TYPEOF(NULLIF(BIGNUMERIC '1.25', BIGNUMERIC '1.25'))
=> "BIGNUMERIC"

SELECT TYPEOF(NULLIF(1.0, 1.0))
=> "FLOAT64"

# NaN compares unequal to itself. Columns prevent analyzer constant folding.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/operators#comparison_operators
SELECT IS_NAN(NULLIF(x, x)) FROM UNNEST([CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)]) x
=> "true"

SELECT NULLIF(x, CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)) FROM UNNEST([1.0]) x
=> "1.0"

SELECT NULLIF(x, x) FROM UNNEST([CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)]) x
=> null

SELECT NULLIF(x, 0.0) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64)]) x
=> null

SELECT NULLIF(x, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64)) FROM UNNEST([1.0]) x
=> "1.0"

# Reusing a nontrivial first argument must evaluate it once, including scalar subqueries.
SELECT NULLIF((SELECT MAX(a) FROM t), 1)
=> "3"

SELECT NULLIF(a + 1, (SELECT MAX(a) FROM t)) FROM t WHERE a = 2
=> null

# The result can only be NULL or 2, even when the argument is volatile.
SELECT COUNTIF(NULLIF(IF(RAND() < 0.5, 1, 2), 1) = 1) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 1000))
=> "0"

# The expansion remains an expression that an enclosing condition can skip.
SELECT IF(TRUE, 42, NULLIF(ERROR('unreachable'), 0))
=> "42"

SELECT NULLIF(ERROR('nullif argument'), 0)
=> error contains: nullif argument
